- [Technical SEO](https://zaminabbas.tech/services/technical-seo): full technical audits, site speed and Core Web Vitals, crawlability and indexation, schema markup, and fixes for broken links, redirects and duplicate content.

- [Google Ads](https://zaminabbas.tech/services/google-ads): tightly targeted search campaigns with conversion and call tracking, negative keyword sculpting, weekly optimization, and transparent reporting.
